name: Webhook PR Review
description: Reviews a GitHub pull request using MCP tools, notifies a Slack channel with the draft review, pauses for human approval, then posts the approved review as a GitHub comment and confirms on Slack.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repo format

fetch_pr.description: Retrieve the full diff, list of changed files, and any inline review comments already present on this PR. Capture the content needed to assess the change.
fetch_pr.prompt:
Retrieve the full diff, list of changed files, and any inline review comments
already present on PR #{{ run.params.pr_number }} in {{ run.params.repo }}.
Owner: {{ run.params.repo_owner }}, repo: {{ run.params.repo_name }}.
Use get_pull_request to fetch PR metadata and get_pull_request_files for the
list of changed files. Summarise what changed in diff_summary and list the
changed file paths in changed_files.

analyze_changes.description: Using the diff and file list from fetch_pr, analyze the change for correctness, style, test coverage, and security concerns. Draft a concise review comment (max 500 words) that summarizes findings and any blocking issues.

approve_review.description: Present the drafted review to a human reviewer. They may approve it for posting or reject it to discard this run without commenting on the PR.

resolution_messages.approve: Review approved — posting to GitHub PR.
resolution_messages.reject: Review rejected — run will not continue.

post_review.description: Post the approved review body as a PR review comment on GitHub.

notify_posted.description: Confirm on Slack that the review was posted to GitHub.
